name: Ring of Animal Affection
body:
Aura faint enchantment; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring resembles a ring of animal friendship and functions as such. Any animal that fails its Will save when the wearer uses the charm animal ability has a 10% chance of becoming overly affectionate to the wearer, treating her as if she were the animal’s offspring. Additionally, the animal becomes hostile to other creatures, including the wearer’s allies, within a 50 foot radius of the wearer and will attack them to “protect” her.

This ring may be removed at any time. However, any animal that was charmed by the wearer remains under the effects instilled by the ring until the charm animal expires.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of animal friendship

Identification DC 28
False Identification DC 18
